skill_name: What are the characteristics of effective leadership?
workflow: The characteristics of effective leadership include excellent communication, clear vision and goal setting, motivation, trust, collaboration and teamwork, decision making, empathy, problem-solving and conflict management, honesty and integrity, and resilience. A good leader should be able to effectively communicate their goals, so that team members understand what is expected of them. They should also have a clear vision and set clear goals, as well as display motivation to help their team meet
